description: Main source file for a Flutter-based personal notes application. It includes app setup, note model, local database management via SQLite, state management with Provider, and UI screens for listing, searching, editing, and viewing notes.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: Data model representing a single note with id, title, content, and last updated timestamp.

classes.name: NotesLocalDatabase
classes.description: Singleton class managing CRUD operations with local SQLite database for notes.

classes.name: NotesProvider
classes.description: State management class that interacts with the database and provides note data to UI components.

classes.name: NotesHomeScreen
classes.description: Main screen displaying list of notes, with search, add, view, edit, and delete functionalities.

classes.name: NotesSearchDelegate
classes.description: Custom search delegate providing live searching and filtering of notes.

classes.name: NoteEditorScreen
classes.description: Screen for creating a new note or editing an existing one.

classes.name: NoteDetailsScreen
classes.description: Screen for viewing detailed note information with options to edit or delete.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Program entry point; initializes and runs the Flutter app.

methods.name: loadNotes
methods.description: Loads notes from the database, optionally filtered by a search query.

methods.name: getNotes
methods.description: Retrieves a list of notes matching an optional search term from the database.

methods.name: saveNote
methods.description: Inserts or updates a note in the database.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note identified by its ID from the database.

methods.name: _saveNote
methods.description: Handles saving a note from the note editor screen, differentiating between new and existing notes.

methods.name: _openEditor
methods.description: Opens the note editor screen, passing the selected note if editing.

methods.name: _openDetails
methods.description: Opens the detailed view for a selected note.

methods.name: _delete
methods.description: Handles deletion of a note after user confirmation.
